question: Can the intel lane, within its own scope, resolve the two non-substrate blocking dependencies (C2 semantic contradiction in spec.json and canonical-script absence) that prevent re-running the full-DOM density metric measurement, and does a formal dependency audit confirm the substrate (locatableSample cap) remains the sole remaining runtime-lane blocker?
hypothesis: The C2 semantic contradiction (falsifier says null>observed=FALSIFIED, decision_rule says null>=observed=SURVIVES) can be resolved to a single coherent direction by analyzing the statistical intent of the original FALSIFIED verdict from EXP-INTEL-35112013458, and a concrete canonical-script specification can be produced that unblocks measurement reproducibility. The locatableSample cap in MEASURE_JS remains the sole remaining runtime-lane blocker.
falsifier: If (F1) the C2 contradiction cannot be resolved without introducing a new scientific assumption not present in the original experiment design, OR (F2) the canonical-script specification is inconsistent with the 3-definition per-role filtering algorithm established in EXP-INTEL-35131994346 reconstruct.py, OR (F3) the locatableSample cap has been removed (meaning the substrate blocker was resolved and this experiment's scoping is obsolete), THEN the design work is invalid or superseded.
baselines: B1_SPEC_COHERENCE: Read the frozen spec.json from EXP-INTEL-35137036013 (the last experiment in this chain). Extract the C2 falsifier clause and the C2 decision_rule clause. Document the exact contradiction (falsifier: null>observed=FALSIFIED; decision_rule: null>=observed=SURVIVES). Verify these are still present in the canonical spec at HEAD.

B2_CANONICAL_SCRIPT_ABSENCE: Search the repository for any committed canonical analysis script implementing 3-definition per-role filtering (DEF-FULL-MAP: a+button+input+combobox, DEF-FORM-ONLY: button+combobox, ISOLATED-A-LINK: a only) with cart_1 deduplication and float scaling. Expected: no such script exists at HEAD (confirming the blocking dependency).

B3_MEASURE_JS_CAP: Search MEASURE_JS in research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-34718481334/measure_fullpage_yield.py for the locatableSample cap. Expected: 'if (locatableSample.length < 20)' still present at line 89 (confirming the substrate blocker).
positive_control: The frozen spec.json from the prior experiment (EXP-INTEL-35137036013) contains both the contradictory C2 clauses, confirming the contradiction exists and needs resolution. The canonical script search returns zero matches, confirming the code blocker. The MEASURE_JS cap search returns a match, confirming the substrate blocker.
null_control: If the C2 contradiction has already been resolved in a newer spec.json (i.e., a subsequent experiment corrected it), the resolution work is unnecessary and the experiment is superseded.
measurement_validity: This experiment is a dependency audit and design-resolution exercise, not an outcome-bearing measurement. No browser interaction, no data collection, no model calls required.
All evidence must come from reading committed artifacts (spec.json, code files, MEASURE_JS) — not from re-running measurements.
The C2 resolution must be grounded in the original experiment's statistical intent (the FALSIFIED verdict chain from EXP-INTEL-35112013458), not in post-hoc analysis of new data.
decision_rule:
Conjunctive:

C1_C2_RESOLVED: The C2 semantic contradiction is resolved to a single coherent direction that is (a) consistent with the original FALSIFIED verdict's statistical intent, (b) unambiguous for both falsifier and decision_rule, and (c) implementable in a canonical analysis script.

C2_CANONICAL_SPEC_PRODUCED: A concrete canonical-script specification exists that specifies: (a) 3-definition per-role filtering (DEF-FULL-MAP, DEF-FORM-ONLY, ISOLATED-A-LINK), (b) cart_1 deduplication, (c) float scaling, (d) null-model implementation (random ROLE_MAP, seed, iterations), (e) C1/C2 evaluation logic using the resolved C2 direction.

C3_SUBSTRATE_BLOCKER_CONFIRMED: The locatableSample cap is still present in MEASURE_JS (runtime lane has not addressed the substrate dependency).

VERDICT RULES:
- If C1=true AND C2=true AND C3=true: BLOCKING_REDUCED (two of three blockers resolved by intel lane; only substrate fix remains, routing to runtime)
- If C1=true AND C2=true AND C3=false: SUPERSEDED (substrate fix already applied; the canonical-script and C2 work is still useful but the experiment's blocking premise is obsolete)
- If C1=false OR C2=false: DESIGN_FAILED (the contradiction cannot be resolved or the canonical spec is inconsistent; re-examine the original experiment chain)
- If C3=false AND (C1=false OR C2=false): SUPERSEDED_WITH_DESIGN_FAILED
product_consequence_positive: If BLOCKING_REDUCED: The intel lane has resolved two of three blocking dependencies within its own scope. The next re-run of the full-DOM density metric measurement has only one remaining blocker (runtime substrate fix), making the path to a valid measurement concrete. Product lane gains a reproducible canonical-script specification that can be committed by any lane.
product_consequence_negative: If DESIGN_FAILED: The C2 contradiction or canonical-script inconsistency cannot be resolved without new scientific assumptions. The full-DOM density metric measurement chain is blocked at a deeper level than previously recognized. Product lane must not adopt the density-based ordering metric until the underlying statistical framework is clarified.
estimated_cost: Minimal: offline code/spec reading and analysis. No browser interaction, no data collection, no model calls. Compute cost: near zero (file reads and text analysis).
expected_information_gain: Medium-high: resolves a blocking design ambiguity that has persisted across 4 experiments (EXP-INTEL-35112013458 → 35124660457 → 35131994346 → 35137036013). A clear resolution either unblocks the next measurement or reveals a deeper problem in the statistical framework.
